published_source_detail: Authors' Stata log shipped in the package (11. table 6d/Table 6d_regression_log.pdf); article text not in the project, so printed table values are unverified. Event specs: published_coef is the equal-weight average of the logged post bins; published_se is null (bin covariance not in the log).
replication_status: exact (authors' code reproduces the shipped log, whose 2 post bins equal printed Table 14 column (2) y+1..y+2 = -0.045, -0.022 (t = -1.510, -0.459) to the printed decimals; published_coef -0.0335 is their equal-weight average (log average -0.03382135); N 1,521; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
replication_vs_log: exact (fixest = authors' reghdfe keepsing log to all printed digits; N and clusters match)
notes: share of agenda items voted against management (a). Authors' code (11. table 6d/Table 6d_regression.do, line 12): reghdfe didntgowithmgmt_a t_plus1 t_plus2 if j>-3 & j<2, a(wficn1 year) cluster(wficn1) keepsing. Sample: annual fund-year panel iss_annual_shareholderonly_dik.dta, opentonewinv==1 (the j filter is vacuous: j==1 on every row); rows are fund classes 1-4 = two fund-years before and two after signing (post = class>=3). Treatment D = post_pri = 1 from the fund's first post-signing year (absorbing in calendar time, verified); gvar = gy. fixest (fixef.rm = none) reproduces the log: coef -0.03382138 vs -0.03382135, N 1521 vs 1521, clusters 553 vs 553. Regression sample: N = 1521, 553 funds, 14 consecutive years. Cohorts (first post-signing year): 12, of which 12 have both treated and untreated rows in the sample. In 11 of the 12 treated periods another cohort supplies untreated rows (not-yet-signed funds; 36 funds with no dated post-signing year are never treated within the sample). Funds observed only after signing in the sample (always-treated within sample): 214 (23.1% of rows); funds observed only before signing: 7. Event study: the authors' dynamic columns use post-only bins t_plus1..t_plus2 (= class 3, class 4) with all pre-signing rows pooled as the reference. run_spec.R with event_pre_min = 0 and event_post_max = 1 reproduces this structure (pre rows -> reference -1) but bins by CALENDAR relative time; 11 treated rows fall in a different bin and 11 rows with calendar relative time > 1 go to the separate endpoint bin (excluded from the post average). Authors' post average (equal weight over the 2 bins) = -0.0338214; calendar-bin TWFE post average on the same sample = -0.0418612 (raw units). A fully dynamic specification with leads is not used because, without never-treated funds, unit FE + period FE + all relative-time dummies are collinear. Table/column labels are inferred from package folder names and code order (no article text). run_spec.R also maps funds that signed before the first sample period to period 1, which shifts their relative-time bins (TVL spec: 35 funds, 113 rows).

event_structure.source: 11. table 6d/Table 6d_regression.do line 12: reghdfe didntgowithmgmt_a t_plus1 t_plus2 if j>-3 & j<2, a(wficn1 year) cluster(wficn1) keepsing. t_plus1 = class 3 (first post-signing fund-year), t_plus2 = class 4; classes 1-2 (the fund-years of and before signing) are the pooled reference; 36 funds without a dated post-signing year are never treated. Pipeline rel = year - gy: class 3 is rel 0 on every row and class 4 is rel 1 (378 rows), 2 (10) or 3 (1) after a gap year, hence the open bin [1,null]; classes 1-2 are rel <= -1.
event_structure.verified: fixest with this structure (es_assign, gvar gy) reproduces the 2 logged coefficients exactly, max abs diff 4.99e-08 (log rounding), N 1521 = reghdfe keepsing.
